finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, not noise.

`[options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6)` read `options.retries`. The bump renamed it `retryCount`. Now it takes either.

`[retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8)` threw on an unset flag. Unset now means off.

The 8 warnings are all deprecations. `Buffer()`, `punycode`, `crypto.createCipher` and five more. They do not break the build. Worth a separate pass before v5.
